question: How many complaints were filed in Brooklyn in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM nyc_311 WHERE borough = 'BROOKLYN' AND STRFTIME('%Y', created_date) = '2023' LIMIT 200;

question: What are the top 5 most common complaint types across all boroughs?
gold_sql: SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM nyc_311 GROUP BY complaint_type ORDER BY complaint_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which borough has the highest number of noise complaints?
gold_sql: SELECT borough, COUNT(*) AS noise_count FROM nyc_311 WHERE LOWER(complaint_type) LIKE '%noise%' GROUP BY borough ORDER BY noise_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average resolution time in days for each borough?
gold_sql: SELECT borough, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(closed_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)), 2) AS avg_resolution_days FROM nyc_311 WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL AND created_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY borough ORDER BY avg_resolution_days ASC LIMIT 200;

question: How many complaints are currently still open?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_complaints FROM nyc_311 WHERE status = 'Open' OR closed_date IS NULL LIMIT 200;

question: Which agency handles the most service requests?
gold_sql: SELECT agency, agency_name, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM nyc_311 GROUP BY agency, agency_name ORDER BY request_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show me the number of complaints filed each month in 2023
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', created_date) AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM nyc_311 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', created_date) = '2023' GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month ASC LIMIT 200;

question: What percentage of complaints were resolved within 7 days?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (JULIANDAY(closed_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_resolved_within_7_days FROM nyc_311 WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200;

question: Which complaint type takes the longest to resolve on average?
gold_sql: SELECT complaint_type, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(closed_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)), 2) AS avg_days FROM nyc_311 WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY complaint_type ORDER BY avg_days DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show me all complaint types in Manhattan with more than 1000 reports
gold_sql: SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) AS report_count FROM nyc_311 WHERE borough = 'MANHATTAN' GROUP BY complaint_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY report_count DESC LIMIT 200;

question: Which borough had the most complaints in summer 2023 (June-August)?
gold_sql: SELECT borough, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM nyc_311 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', created_date) = '2023' AND STRFTIME('%m', created_date) IN ('06', '07', '08') GROUP BY borough ORDER BY complaint_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the top 3 complaint types in Queens?
gold_sql: SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM nyc_311 WHERE borough = 'QUEENS' GROUP BY complaint_type ORDER BY complaint_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many complaints were filed on weekends vs weekdays?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%w', created_date) IN ('0', '6') THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM nyc_311 GROUP BY day_type ORDER BY complaint_count DESC LIMIT 200;

question: Which agency has the fastest average resolution time?
gold_sql: SELECT agency, agency_name, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(closed_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)), 2) AS avg_days FROM nyc_311 WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agency, agency_name ORDER BY avg_days ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Show complaints by borough with their average resolution days sorted fastest to slowest
gold_sql: SELECT borough, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(closed_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)), 2) AS avg_resolution_days FROM nyc_311 WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY borough ORDER BY avg_resolution_days ASC LIMIT 200;

question: What is the most common complaint type for each borough?
gold_sql: SELECT borough, complaint_type, complaint_count FROM (SELECT borough, complaint_type, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY borough ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM nyc_311 GROUP BY borough, complaint_type) ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY borough LIMIT 200;

question: How many unique complaint types exist in the dataset?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT complaint_type) AS unique_complaint_types FROM nyc_311 LIMIT 200;

question: Which city outside of the 5 boroughs has the most complaints?
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM nyc_311 WHERE borough NOT IN ('BROOKLYN', 'MANHATTAN', 'QUEENS', 'BRONX', 'STATEN ISLAND') AND city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city ORDER BY complaint_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What percentage of complaints have no closed date (still open)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN closed_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_no_closed_date FROM nyc_311 LIMIT 200;

question: Show the top 5 descriptor types for noise complaints in the Bronx
gold_sql: SELECT descriptor, COUNT(*) AS count FROM nyc_311 WHERE borough = 'BRONX' AND LOWER(complaint_type) LIKE '%noise%' GROUP BY descriptor ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the total revenue generated in 2018?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' LIMIT 200;

question: Which product category has the highest average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average delivery time in days across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200;

question: Show the top 10 sellers by total revenue
gold_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What percentage of orders have a 5-star review score?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_five_star FROM order_reviews LIMIT 200;

question: Which payment method is most commonly used?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which state has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average review score by product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC LIMIT 200;

question: Show monthly order counts for 2018
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month ASC LIMIT 200;

question: Which product category has the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average freight value by seller state?
gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 200;

question: How many orders were delivered late (after estimated delivery date)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200;

question: Which sellers have an average review score below 3?
gold_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY oi.seller_id HAVING AVG(r.review_score) < 3 ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 200;

question: What is the average number of items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM order_items LIMIT 200;

question: Show total revenue by payment type
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 200;

question: Which 5 cities have the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What percentage of orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_cancelled FROM orders LIMIT 200;

question: What is the average time between order purchase and approval?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(order_approved_at) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS avg_approval_days FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200;

question: Which product category generates the most total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the top 5 states by average order value
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many patients are in the dataset?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients LIMIT 200;

question: What is the gender distribution of patients?
gold_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM patients GROUP BY gender ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 200;

question: What are the top 10 most common diagnoses?
gold_sql: SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count FROM conditions GROUP BY description ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average healthcare cost per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(healthcare_expenses), 2) AS avg_healthcare_expenses FROM patients LIMIT 200;

question: Which state has the most patients?
gold_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients GROUP BY state ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the most commonly prescribed medication?
gold_sql: SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS prescription_count FROM medications GROUP BY description ORDER BY prescription_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many patients have diabetes as a condition?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS diabetes_patients FROM conditions WHERE LOWER(description) LIKE '%diabetes%' LIMIT 200;

question: What is the average number of encounters per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT patient), 2) AS avg_encounters_per_patient FROM encounters LIMIT 200;

question: Which encounter class (inpatient, outpatient, emergency) is most common?
gold_sql: SELECT encounterclass, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count FROM encounters GROUP BY encounterclass ORDER BY encounter_count DESC LIMIT 200;

question: What is the average total claim cost by encounter type?
gold_sql: SELECT encounterclass, ROUND(AVG(total_claim_cost), 2) AS avg_total_claim_cost FROM encounters GROUP BY encounterclass ORDER BY avg_total_claim_cost DESC LIMIT 200;

question: How many patients have at least one allergy?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS patients_with_allergies FROM allergies LIMIT 200;

question: What are the top 5 most common procedures?
gold_sql: SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS procedure_count FROM procedures GROUP BY description ORDER BY procedure_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average age of patients at their first encounter?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST((JULIANDAY(e.first_encounter) - JULIANDAY(p.birthdate)) / 365.25 AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_age_first_encounter FROM patients p JOIN (SELECT patient, MIN(start) AS first_encounter FROM encounters GROUP BY patient) e ON e.patient = p.id LIMIT 200;

question: How many patients died during the recorded period?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS deceased_patients FROM patients WHERE deathdate IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200;

question: Which conditions have the highest average medication cost?
gold_sql: SELECT reasondescription, ROUND(AVG(totalcost), 2) AS avg_medication_cost FROM medications WHERE reasondescription IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reasondescription ORDER BY avg_medication_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average payer coverage percentage across all encounters?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_claim_cost > 0 THEN payer_coverage / total_claim_cost * 100 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS avg_payer_coverage_pct FROM encounters WHERE total_claim_cost IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200;

question: How many unique medications are prescribed in the dataset?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT description) AS unique_medications FROM medications LIMIT 200;

question: What are the top 3 most common allergy categories?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS allergy_count FROM allergies WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY allergy_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Show the number of encounters per year
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', start) AS year, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count FROM encounters WHERE start IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 200;
